analytic_review.clearing: L_ij is the suffix rectangle product of (a_u+c_v); multiplying the race recurrence gives integer P_ij and A_ij
analytic_review.ordered_gaps: All mixed-sign nonzero b reduce by permutation and reflection to four cases k=1..4; cumulative nonnegative gaps cover repeats
analytic_review.positive_factor: k=1 verifies N=a_1^7 times the smaller polynomial before checking coefficients
analytic_review.strictness: Positive coefficients and positive all-means-one specialization imply a positive monomial using only the two strictly positive first gaps
analytic_review.boundary: At nonzero b the exponential sum has no atom at zero; dominated convergence gives continuity; b=0 and one-sign vectors give affine simplices
